items.title: Old Scales, New Psychiatry: Reconceptualizing Endpoint Strategy
items.desc: Old Scales, New Psychiatry: Reconceptualizing Endpoint Strategy scox Mon, 11/23/2026 - 14:30 Wed, 01/27/2027 - 11:00 Resource Type Webinar Paul O’Donohoe Luka Lucić, PhD Psychiatry is undergoing its most significant shift in decades. Novel therapies, including expanding into previously uncharted areas such as psychedelic-based treatments and GLP-1 receptor agonists, are challenging longstanding assumptions about how quickly patients can experience meaningful clinical improvement. Yet the gold-standard endpoints used in psychiatric research today were largely developed for treatments whose effects might be more palliative than holistic, and emerged gradually. As study designs compress timelines and increase measurement frequency, sponsors face a critical balance: maintaining psychometric integrity while modernizing data collection. In this webinar, Paul O'Donohoe, Senior Director, eCOA Science and Product at Medidata, and Dr. Luka Lucić, Senior Director, Clinical Science, Psychiatry at Cogstate, will explore how emerging psychiatry trials are reshaping assessment strategies. Drawing on their decades of experience, they will break down actionable strategies for managing higher assessment frequency, deploying hybrid and remote data collection, standardizing rater training, and implementing proactive data quality oversight to safeguard trial endpoints. Key Takeaways How to balance psychiatric rating scales with the operational realities of rapid-response therapies. How increased assessment frequency is changing rater training, study operations, and protocol execution.
